page.layout: One column of running text; a large woodcut ornament stands in the middle of the page below the text; the catchword sits at the right below the ornament. Faint show-through from the other side is left out.

main_text.p: oppido titulo pignoris jam dudum possederat) occuparet: Adolphus tamè Marcanus, quia mater ejus adhuc superstes, Herculeorum verò excesserat, ad se ob eandem quæ utpote fratris filia, sororis filio Theodorico Hornano & Parwyschio in feudo proximior erat, successionem devolutam propositit, & Ottoni Herculeo, atque Theodorico Hornano, ex reconciliatione Ioannæ Brabantinæ, pecuniâ numeratâ, fratrique Engelberto integro Comitatu Marcano cum Limetha, & medietate telonii Buiricensis, Theodorico vero Domino Dinslacensi, Duisburgensi urbe, & reditibus Ruurorthensibus assignatis, Provincialium, inprimis Heymriciorum favore, Comitatum Clivensem adeptus, eoque à Carolo IV. Imperatore investitus est, factusque Clivorum Comes in ordine 28, & ultimus, de quo in mox Comitibus Marcanis ante Duces Clivenses sex, qui ex iis originem suam habent.

page.notes: The scan is faint; the number at the head is read as 2135 with some doubt. Show-through text from the reverse side (lower half of the page and the margins) is omitted. The word at the foot right, VNITA-, is taken as a catchword. Some words in the top paragraph are doubtful, such as "propositit" and "Parwyschio", and are copied as they appear.
